pages.name: Bird: 1...d5 2.Nf3 Nf6 3.g3 g6
pages.notes: Plan had the f3-knight going via e1 to d3 with the king on e1; plans vague. Rewritten around the fight for e4.

pages.name: Bird: 1...d5 2.Nf3 Nf6 3.g3 g6: 6.d3 c5
pages.notes: Plan had the b1-knight via d2-f1-e3 through the f1-rook. Rewritten around Qe1/Nc3 and e4 against ...Nc6, ...b5 and ...d4.

pages.name: Bird: Lasker Variation
pages.notes: Plan had Ne5 without Nf3, and ...b6/...Bb7 to challenge the f4-pawn. Rewritten; reviewer rejection (...g6 against a Stonewall's dark squares, which its pawns cover) fixed to the e4 hole and re-reviewed.

pages.name: Modern Defense: Semi-Averbakh Variation, Pterodactyl Variation Accepted
pages.notes: Plan had Black pressing a d4-pawn that has gone (dxc5). Rewritten around 5...Qa5+, ...Qxc5 and White's Maroczy-style centre.

pages.name: Reti: 1...c5
pages.notes: Plans without side prefixes and the a1-h8 diagonal read as a move. Rewritten around Symmetrical English and KIA transpositions.

pages.name: Reti: 1...c5
pages.notes: Plan had White's Nbd2-f1-e3 with the rook on f1; plans without side prefixes. Rewritten around the e4/c4 and ...d5/...e5 breaks.

pages.name: Reti: 1...c5
pages.notes: Plan had Black exchanging dark-squared bishops to neutralise White's key attacking piece (the g2-bishop is light-squared); f4-f5 and g4-g5 routes. Rewritten as a Closed Sicilian-type structure.

pages.name: Reti: 1...c5
pages.notes: Plan had ...g6/...Bg7 neutralising the g2-bishop (different diagonal); plans without side prefixes. Rewritten.

pages.name: Reti: 1...c5, Nimzowitsch-Larsen
pages.notes: Plan had Black neutralising the Bb2 by unclear means; American spelling. Rewritten around ...d5/...Nc6 and the e5 outpost.

pages.name: Reti: 1...f5 2.d4
pages.notes: Plan had ...Qe8-h5 with the king on e8; American spelling. Rewritten around the three Dutch set-ups.
